# France

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### CFONB - Comite francais d'organisation et de normalisation bancaires

**Role:** French banking community implementation-guideline publisher

**Reporting coverage:** National CAMT 053 and CAMT 054 implementation guidelines; 052 is described as an intraday message, but no separate 052 guide was found.

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.02 (context); camt.053.001.02; camt.054.001.02; camt.086; pain.002

- [Public reporting guides](https://www.cfonb.org/organisation-des-echanges/restitution-dinformation) — availability; public-page
- [CAMT 053 national guide 1.3, November 2022](https://www.cfonb.org/sites/www.cfonb.org/files/documents/Guide%20d%27utilisation%20ISO20022%20-%20Relev%C3%A9%20de%20compte%20-%20camt%20053%20-%20V%201.3%20-%2011%202022%20-%20Valid%C3%A9_0.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [CAMT 054 national guide 1.4, November 2022](https://www.cfonb.org/sites/www.cfonb.org/files/documents/Guide%20d%27utilisation%20ISO20022%20-%20Relev%C3%A9s%20d%27op%C3%A9rations%20-%20camt.054%20-%20v.1.4%20-%2011%202022%20-%20Valid%C3%A9.pdf) — specification; public-file

Public 134-page 053 guide and 86-page 054 guide verified. They use ISO 2009 version 02; guideline versions 1.3/1.4 are separate publication numbers. Landing also publishes an 086 billing guide and sample annexes. Member-only documentation is separate from these public guides.
